## Pull request overview

This PR fixes TypeScript composite project compilation errors (TS6059/TS6307) in three plugin packages by removing the `rootDir` constraint and adding configuration options to handle workspace dependencies. The changes aim to align these packages with working configurations in `plugin-aggrid`, `plugin-charts`, and `plugin-editor`.

**Changes:**
- Removed `rootDir` compiler option to allow TypeScript to include source files from workspace dependencies
- Added `jsx`, `baseUrl`, `paths`, `noEmit`, `declaration`, `composite`, and `skipLibCheck` options
- Standardized `include` pattern to `["src"]` instead of `["src/**/*"]`
- Added `declarationMap: true` and `exclude` array to all three packages

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 9 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-kanban/tsconfig.json | Updated TypeScript configuration to remove `rootDir` and add composite project options for workspace dependency compatibility |
| packages/plugin-markdown/tsconfig.json | Updated TypeScript configuration to remove `rootDir` and add composite project options for workspace dependency compatibility |
| packages/plugin-object/tsconfig.json | Updated TypeScript configuration to remove `rootDir` and add composite project options for workspace dependency compatibility |

The reference packages (`plugin-aggrid`, `plugin-charts`, and `plugin-editor`) do not include an `exclude` array in their tsconfig.json. For consistency with the stated goal of aligning with those configurations, this should be removed (see packages/plugin-aggrid/tsconfig.json:1-17, packages/plugin-charts/tsconfig.json:1-17, packages/plugin-editor/tsconfig.json:1-17).

The reference packages include `noImplicitAny: true` in their compiler options for stricter type checking. This option should be added to match the pattern established in packages/plugin-aggrid/tsconfig.json:10, packages/plugin-charts/tsconfig.json:10, and packages/plugin-editor/tsconfig.json:10.
